source: But L1 hit rate is not a universal performance score. A kernel can have a high hit rate and still be limited by instruction issue, serialization, shared-memory conflicts, or some other resource. Conversely, a streaming kernel may intentionally have little temporal reuse and still perform well if its accesses are coalesced and device bandwidth is used efficiently.
zh: 但L1命中率并不是通用的性能分数。内核可以具有很高的命中率，但仍然受到指令问题、序列化、共享内存冲突或某些其他资源的限制。相反，如果流内核的访问被合并并且设备带宽得到有效利用，则流内核可能有意地具有很少的时间重用并且仍然表现良好。
